description: Side-by-side historical records for two US cities with the difference in Clean Air Score and PM2.5. Warnings list any copied record. Each city is either an own_record (scored from its own data) or a copied_record (the full record of the nearest scored city, named in source_city, source_state and source_distance_miles). A copied_record describes the source city, not measurements taken in the named city. Values are historical annual data, not the current AQI.
name: compare_cities
title: Compare two cities
